nonBlockingObservations.title: Describe the regular-file envelope without claiming all sources are opened no-follow
nonBlockingObservations.detail: SCOPE.md LD-B3B3A1-2 and the model read_envelope docstring say every D15 read is opened no-follow. Item 6b system sources deliberately use open_fixed_regular_following and may follow symbolic links; the resulting file must still be regular. This does not invalidate the stated regular-file read envelope, but the wording should distinguish member/carrier/provider evidence from refusal-only system sources.
